crossRefs.note: Go to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord…
He said to me, “Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a nation of rebels who have rebelled against me.…
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of…
Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He said to me, “Son of man, go to the house of Israel, and speak my words to them.
translations.bsb: Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.
translations.kjv: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
